title: Rapid-MLX 0.16.9: 47x faster first token on repeated long prompts (32K prompt 18.6 s to 0.39 s) and Flint 40B at 131 tok/s on a 36 GB Mac
headline: Rapid-MLX 0.16.9 cuts repeat long-prompt start to 0.39 s
lede: On Apple Silicon you can reuse prompt state so a repeated ~32K-token prompt starts in 0.39 s instead of 18.6 s, and run Flint 40B at 131 tok/s on a 36 GB Mac with tool calls.
